notes: Question paper and answer book PDFs are SCANS with no text layer (PyMuPDF get_text is empty); ingestion needs OCR/vision. The memo has a text layer. Annexures A-D (route map, floor plans, GPS map, bookcase diagrams) live in the ANSWER BOOK, not the paper; Annexure D is a rotated landscape page. No part needs a learner-filled table, a graph plot, or on-map coordinates/bearings. Cross-cutting caveats not counted as separate needs: (1) the memo gives alternative solution routes for 2.2.4, 2.3.2, 3.1.3, 3.1.4, 3.1.5, 4.2.2, 4.2.6, 5.2, 5.3; fixed steps accept one route (learner is guided down it). (2) Method marks (MA/SF/S/C) are awarded for method even after an arithmetic slip; number-only steps award them only through the step value plus follow-through, so app marking is stricter than the memo for a slip inside a step. (3) Several 2-mark answers split 1+1 in the memo (2.1.2 row+seat, 5.1.2 numerator+denominator); term/num are all-or-nothing. (4) Phone legibility: the seat plan (2.1.1) and national-road icons (4.1.2a) need pinch-zoom/high-res images on a 360 px screen. Choices: 2.1.3 cloze counted as fits via 4 mcq; 1.1.x needs match distractors because 10 options exceed mcq's 6-option cap.
